notes.title: New Chapter announcement and Steam summer sales
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40214014/c0267d50235231a86da9e1d16f97a6ee93a02044.png[/img]

We are glad to announce [b]Mark & Lara: Partners in Justice - Chapter 2[/b]! The new chapter will be available in [b]Winter 2021[/b].

[i]“A murdered policeman, a suspect, and a new case. Can you solve the mystery and find the truth?”[/i]

[previewyoutube=qhsJWO7aft0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for supporting us and for all your kind words!

And it’s not over, don’t miss Steam Summer Sale: [b]30% off[/b] on Mark & Lara: Partners In Justice, available [b]from June 24th to July 8th[/b] on Steam! Tell your friends!

Stay tuned and follow us on:

[url=https://www.facebook.com/DeepMonolith]Facebook[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/DeepMonolith]Twitter[/url]

Good luck and have fun, Detectives! ːsteamfacepalmː

Deep Monolith Team

notes.title: First update! Improved English localization and more!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce Mark & Lara: Partners in Justice first update!

Thank you for your feedback, it has been very helpful for improving the game and will continue to be so in the future.

Remember, the game is available on: Windows, iOS, Android, Mac and Linux.

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Improved English localization
[*] Improved the captain's advices
[*] Corrected times and dates in some documents
[*] Added camera shake
[*] Fixed an issue that caused text overflow
[*] Fixed some minor bugs
[/list]

Stay tuned and follow us on:

[url=https://www.facebook.com/DeepMonolith]Facebook[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/DeepMonolith]Twitter[/url]

Good luck and have fun, Detectives! 

Deep Monolith Team

notes.title: Mark & Lara: Partners in Justice is out!
notes.content:
[b]The first two-player co-op detective game is now out![/b]

You can play Mark & Lara: Partners in Justice cross-platform on [b]PC, iOS, Android, Mac and Linux[/b]. 
The game do not require an internet connection! You just need to be able to talk to each other (in any way you want).

Don’t miss out on our special offer! [b]Until the 23th of April the game is 30% off! [/b]
Remember: you need to buy and install the game on 2 devices in order to play together!
Make sure to choose the right partner! ːsteamhappyː

We have plans for the future...  so stay tuned and follow us on:

[url=https://www.facebook.com/DeepMonolith/]Facebook[/url] 

[url=https://twitter.com/deepmonolith]Twitter[/url]

Good luck and have fun! ːsteamfacepalmː
Deep Monolith Team
